tasks.title: Anonymous Login (CLI)
tasks.description: Attempt to log in using Username - ANONYMOUS and Password - blank.

tasks.title: Anonymous Login (Web Browser)
tasks.description: Navigate to the FTP service using a web browser to check for visual directory listings and easy file retrieval.

tasks.title: Download Directory Contents
tasks.description: Turn the interactive prompt off and use Mget * from within the directory to download all contents.

tasks.title: Download & View Specific Files
tasks.description: Use Get <local.txt> to download files, or !cat <local.txt> to view a file's contents directly.

tasks.title: Upload Payload via FTP
tasks.description: Check write permissions. Can you upload a payload?

tasks.title: Execute Uploaded Payload
tasks.description: If upload was successful, visit the FTP site in a web browser and then activate the payload?

tasks.title: GTFObins Shell Escape
tasks.description: Once logged in try and get a shell (GTFObins). Check if the FTP service itself can be exploited to spawn an interactive shell.

tasks.title: Hydra Wordlist Spray
tasks.description: Run hydra with your specific wordlists to brute-force credentials.

tasks.title: CrackMapExec Password Scan
tasks.description: Run password scans using crackmapexec with custom wordlists.
